upgrade_reason: V1 QA allowed 3 pending items to pass at 92. V2.1 introduces two-tier QA: Draft-Ready (90+) and Publish-Ready (95+ with zero pending).

draft_ready.description: Minimum score for draft creation. Pending items allowed but capped.

publish_ready.description: Required score for publishing. Zero pending on P0 checks.

checks.pass_criteria: English buyer-facing title, 50-90 chars, includes product name and key application
checks.fail_note: Title missing, too short, too long, or not buyer-facing

checks.pass_criteria: Present, buyer-facing, 120-160 chars, includes focus keyword
checks.fail_note: Missing, too short/long, or keyword missing

checks.pass_criteria: Kebab-case, includes product name, no stop words
Exactly one H1, matches title intent
H2 sections cover: buyer problem, product fit, specifications, applications, FAQ, CTA
At least 2 internal links (product page + contact page for product content)
checks.fail_note: No internal links for publish-ready content

checks.pass_criteria: External links present if required by content type; no broken links
At least 1 image with descriptive alt text for publish-ready; pending allowed for draft-only
checks.fail_note: Publish-ready content has no images or missing alt text

checks.pass_criteria: At least 3 buyer Q&A pairs with substantive answers
checks.fail_note: Fewer than 3 Q&A pairs or answers too short

checks.pass_criteria: Schema.org markup injected for publish-ready; pending for draft-only
At least 1 CTA (product page link or contact link) with clear action text
No grammar errors, consistent tense, professional tone
No forbidden claims. Uses approved product positioning. No unsupported claims. Follows public_claim_boundary.
checks.fail_note: Forbidden claim detected or unsupported claim made

checks.pass_criteria: For product content: complete specs table with at least 5 parameters from knowledge binding
checks.fail_note: Specs table missing or incomplete for product content type

checks.pass_criteria: At least 1 anonymized customer case or application scenario for publish-ready product content

scoring_rules.pending: Half weight awarded (new in V2.1 - previously zero deduction)
scoring_rules.blocking_fail: Zero weight + QA status set to blocked regardless of total score

golden_standard_reference.description: Post 481 is the benchmark. It passes all P0 checks with full weight, has images, specs table, 6 FAQ, dual CTA, and 6 customer cases.
